definitions.gloss: examination room; consulting room; doctor's office
definitions.explanation: The room in a hospital or clinic where a doctor examines and consults with patients.

examples.japanese: {診察室|しんさつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come into the examination room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧{診察室|しんさつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My name was called and I entered the examination room.

examples.japanese: {診察室|しんさつしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{待|ま}たされた。
examples.english: I was kept waiting for thirty minutes in front of the examination room.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on signs in hospitals and clinics, often numbered (⟦{第|だい}{一|いち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧{診察室|しんさつしつ}, ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{診察室|しんさつしつ}). Patients typically wait in the ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧ (waiting room) until called.

FORMS:
⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧ (medical examination) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). The 〜⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ suffix is productive for room names.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧: waiting room
- {処置室|しょちしつ}: treatment room
- {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}: operating room
